lines.trans: We are broadcasting our report from Krasnoarmeyskaya Street.
Candidate Ivan Samsonov came out into the courtyard. Today he paved over an old pothole himself!
The road service promised to pave it over ten years ago.
Ivan, your rivals hold meetings and make promises.
And today you paved a pothole in a courtyard. Aren't you wasting your time in vain?
What is the point of chattering? Everyone talks, and I act!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!
Hey, I almost broke my car right here!
You laid it unevenly over there! Now there will be a little puddle there!
A little puddle?! I will level out that puddle with you right now! Understood?
I am not going to vote for you! I am leaving here!
Well, I will! So, Ilona, what is next?
All right, the workers can take their roller back.
Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

He painted the wall with a roller.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

meanings.note: pointing at something a little way off
вон отсюда! = get out of here!
after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все

polite to one person, or to several people

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

meanings.note: substantivized adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

meanings.note: Зря ты так = You shouldn't have

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.trans: You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!

examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone.
